# CryptoPriceTicker.com

> Free, ad-free live cryptocurrency prices streamed directly from the public market-data feeds of Coinbase, Binance and Kraken. No account needed. Covers 110+ coins with per-coin pages (performance, 52-week range, monthly price history, per-exchange prices and spread) and sector overviews.

## Main pages
- [Live crypto prices](https://cryptopriceticker.com/): live table of 110+ coins by market cap, sector filters, biggest movers
- [About & data methodology](https://cryptopriceticker.com/about/): data sources and how market cap, volume, depth and performance are calculated
- [Free website widget](https://cryptopriceticker.com/widgets/): embeddable live crypto ticker (iframe)

- [Layer 2](https://cryptopriceticker.com/sector/layer-2/)

- [Memecoins](https://cryptopriceticker.com/sector/memecoins/)
- [Stablecoins](https://cryptopriceticker.com/sector/stablecoins/)

## Coin pages
Every coin has a page at `https://cryptopriceticker.com/coin/<ticker>/` (lowercase), for example [Bitcoin](https://cryptopriceticker.com/coin/btc/) and [Ethereum](https://cryptopriceticker.com/coin/eth/). The full list is in the [sitemap](https://cryptopriceticker.com/sitemap.xml).

## Notes
- Prices on the pages update live in the browser; the static HTML contains weekly snapshots with their dates.
- Not financial advice.
